demand_not_found.looked_in: www/dynamodb/dax, www/dynamodbaccelerator, pricing pages, guide search 'data transfer'
demand_not_found.result: not stated; the pricing page example only shows a per-node-hour charge ($0.04 x 3 nodes for t2.small), recorded as dax-pricing-example-t2small-004-node-hour
AWS gives no number; only 'doesn't allow you to increase provisioned capacity very rapidly' (dynamodb-provisioned-no-rapid-increase) and the decrease quota 4 + 1 per hour, up to 27 per day

source_notes: The DAX marketing page (www/dynamodb/dax and www/dynamodbaccelerator) says 'up to a 10-node cluster'; the developer guide (Constraints, DAX.concepts.cluster) says one primary plus up to 10 read replicas, 11 nodes. The guide is current truth; the marketing sentence was not added as a fact.

On-demand per-million prices (WRU $0.6250, RRU $0.125) appear on the pricing pages only inside example tables that the tool cannot parse as tables, and in sentences of worked examples. Recorded as example prices with Region scope: dynamodb-pricing-gt-rwru-example-0625 ($0.6250 per million replicated write request units), storage $0.25 and $0.10 per GB, backup $0.10, PITR $0.20, restore $0.15, DAX t2.small $0.04 per node. The RRU price $0.125 per million has no sentence quote and was not added.

The Constraints page and the old ServiceQuotas page disagree on nothing; ServiceQuotas now holds only quotas (table counts, throughput, global tables, indexes, streams, import, export, backup). Item size 400 KB, transaction 100 items and 4 MB, BatchGet/BatchWrite limits, key lengths and DAX limits are on Constraints.

Tables per account default is 2,500 (history row: 256 to 2,500 on March 9, 2022, fact dynamodb-change-tables-per-account-256-to-2500). Concurrent table management operations 50 to 500 (same row) not added as a separate fact.

Vector index quotas (5 indexes per table, 4,096 dimensions, TopK 100, 18 inline filters, 600 GB) are on ServiceQuotas table 3 and were not added: the feature is outside the exam task statements; FAQ lens facts cover dimensions, TopK and index count.
Reserved capacity: the guide says 'up to 54%' for a one-year term and '77%' for three years; the pricing page repeats it. Three-year terms are in select Regions only.
Pricing facts of kind price carry volatility frequently-changing; they need the currency vote.
Miner-checked claims were trimmed to what each quote says (21 amends by mine-28-numbers); the amend label is mine-28-numbers, so these facts need independent voters.
